annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, source-level algorithm linkage, dimension-only constants, local roundoff analysis, and full finite Lemma 4.3 reconstruction

assumptions: The system dimension n is positive, A is nonsingular with a two-sided inverse Ainv, and x is the exact solution of A*x=b.

The iterates, computed residuals, and corrections form the paper's column-pivoted iterative-refinement run. The actual solves and updates start at m=1; x_0=0, r_0=-b, and d_0=-x_1 are auxiliary definitions only.

The residual subtraction is performed last; residual accumulation is single precision with ubar=u or double precision with ubar=u^2 followed by conversion to working precision, as captured by the displayed residual-error equation and bound.
The positive working unit roundoff satisfies n*u<=0.01, and all represented floating-point results are assumed well-defined.

The initial solve and each positive-index correction use the paper's displayed componentwise column-pivoted-solve certificate with nonnegative C_1; no unspecified pivot-state or back-substitution implementation is imposed.
The rounded update is represented by x_(m+1)=x_m-d_m+h_(m+1) with the source componentwise bound |h_(m+1)|<=u*|x_m-d_m|.
The chosen vector norm is absolute, monotone, normalized on basis vectors, and extended to its induced matrix norm; kappa(Ainv)=||abs(A)*abs(Ainv)||.

C_2,C_6,...,C_12 and c_1,c_3,c_4,c_5,c_8 satisfy the exact definitions and nonnegativity properties printed in the Notes on pages 823, 826, and 827, and explicit scalar and entrywise envelopes bound them by functions of n fixed before A and b.

The residual-accumulation error equation and its componentwise bound, together with the equation-(3.1) correction-error equation and bound, are available; Lemma 4.1, Lemma 4.2, the page-827 recurrence, and the Lemma 4.3 conclusion are not assumed.
The final smallness condition is c_8*u*kappa(Ainv)<=1/2; c_1<=c_8 supplies the earlier Lemma 4.1 condition.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p08_t3_lemma_4_3_exact_residual_bound {n : Nat} (dimensionBounds : P08DimensionOnlyConstantBounds) (run : P08IterativeRefinementRun n) (norm : P08AbsoluteMonotoneNorm n) (constants : P08Lemma43Constants run norm dimensionBounds) (roundoff : P08Lemma43RoundoffAnalysis run norm dimensionBounds constants) (hsmall : constants.c8 * run.u * p08KappaInverse run norm <= 1/2) : forall m i, abs (p08ExactResidualAfterCorrection run m i) <= p08Lemma43Bound constants m i
formal_statement.plain_language: For every iteration m, the exact residual q_(m+1) of the linked column-pivoted iterative-refinement run satisfies Lemma 4.3's complete four-term componentwise finite bound under the source c_8*u*kappa(A^{-1}) threshold.

informal_proof: Use c_1<=c_8 to obtain the equation-(3.1) smallness condition. Combine the residual-accumulation error and correction-solve error, then expand the printed definitions of C_6 and C_7, to derive Lemma 4.1. Derive Lemma 4.2's forward bound from x_m-d_m-x=Ainv*q_(m+1) and the rounded update. The m=0 Lemma 4.1 instance and x_0=0 give the q_1 coefficient C_10. Substitution at m+1 gives the source recurrence with propagation u*C_8*|A|*|Ainv| and forcing terms containing C_9 and C_7. The C_11 and C_12 resolvent identities make the stationary terms a fixed supersolution, and componentwise matrix-power induction yields the exact exponent-m four-term bound.
informal_statement: The full algorithm-linked, precision-sensitive, componentwise exact-residual bound of Lemma 4.3, with q_1 as the base case and no artificial q_0.
paper_version: published journal version; volume 35, issue 151, July 1980, printed pages 817-832
